_meta.legal_basis: Indian Contract Act 1872 + Companies Act 2013 + Copyright Act 1957 + Patents Act 1970
_meta.notes: Founders Agreement governs co-founder relationship pre/post incorporation. Often executed before incorporation and superseded/supplemented by SHA at fundraise. Vesting, IP assignment, equity split, exit are core. S.27 Contract Act limits post-exit non-compete; valid as shareholder restriction.

title: Co-Founders Agreement

ip_assignment_scope.default: All pre-incorporation and during-tenure IP related to the business assigned to the Company

mandatory_clauses.title: Founder Vesting / Reverse Vesting
mandatory_clauses.content: Each Founder's equity shall vest over {{vesting_schedule.total_period_months}} months with a cliff of {{vesting_schedule.cliff_months}} months. Unvested shares are subject to repurchase by the Company at par value upon cessation of Founder's full-time engagement.

mandatory_clauses.title: Intellectual Property Assignment
mandatory_clauses.content: Each Founder hereby assigns to the Company all right, title, and interest in any IP (including code, designs, trademarks, copyrights, patents, know-how) created or conceived by the Founder relating to the business of the Company, whether before or during engagement.

mandatory_clauses.title: Non-Compete (during tenure and as shareholder)
mandatory_clauses.note: Post-exit non-compete on Founder qua employee void under S.27 Contract Act. Non-compete qua shareholder (during shareholding) is enforceable.

mandatory_clauses.title: Restrictions on Transfer of Founder Shares
Good Leaver / Bad Leaver Provisions
mandatory_clauses.content: Bad Leaver (resignation without cause within first 4 years, or termination for cause) forfeits unvested shares and vested shares may be repurchased at par. Good Leaver (death, disability, mutual separation) retains vested shares; unvested forfeited.

mandatory_clauses.title: Exit and Departure of a Founder

prompt_context.system_role: You are drafting a Co-Founders Agreement for Indian founders. Cover equity, vesting, IP assignment, roles, exit, and non-compete with awareness of S.27 Contract Act.
drafting_rules: Market standard vesting: 4 years total with 1-year cliff, monthly vesting thereafter.
IP assignment must be express and broad - cover pre-incorporation IP too.
Bad Leaver definition: voluntary resignation without cause, termination for cause (fraud, gross misconduct, breach).
Good Leaver: death, permanent disability, mutual agreement.
Non-compete during tenure - valid. Post-tenure non-compete on Founder as employee void under S.27. Mention shareholder-level non-compete instead.
Equity split should reflect capital + time + IP contributions clearly.
Deadlock: prefer mediation first; buy-sell mechanisms for hard deadlocks.
Pre-incorporation founders agreement should provide for novation/assignment to Company upon incorporation.
Reference Niranjan Shankar Golikari v. Century Spinning [1967] for permitted in-term restraints.

sections: S.17 (works in course of employment), S.18-19 (assignment)

filing_checklist: Execute on stamp paper of value per state Stamp Act.
Mirror key terms (vesting, transfer restriction) in AOA / SHA upon incorporation/fundraise.
If founder IP assigned: record in Company books; record TM/patent assignments with respective registries.
Issue share certificates with restrictive endorsements per vesting.
Retain executed originals with Company secretary.

validation_rules.check: Sum of founder equity_percent equals 100 (or 100 - ESOP pool)
IP clause covers all founder IP
Post-tenure non-compete framed as shareholder restriction, not employee restraint
